claims.citation: Hubbard & Winter, North Atlantic Mail Sailings 1840-75 (USPCS, 1988; rev. 2014), p. 292
New York Herald, 3 May 1866, p. 8, col. 6
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Ericsson, Lowber, Bremen, 20 days, with mdse
and 577 passengers, to Ruger Bros. Had a continuation of
westerly gales since leaving Pentland Frith. Had one birth
and one death (an infant); passengers all well.
